# Predictable Practice Runs

## Statement

The same resolved play produces the same execution every time — coaches can replay, compare, and review runs deterministically.

## Who Feels It

The coach reviewing what went wrong; the developer writing execution tests. Non-determinism makes both impossible.

## Evidence

Grill decision: resolve-then-execute chosen after a prototype with mid-run resolution produced different outcomes per run.
